messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a vendor + lockfile sweep for the 1.12.0 cut. Planning to open a consolidated lockfile PR and vendor roll at 17:40 UTC. Please confirm submodule pins and add changelog snippets if you have user-visible changes. If you have a vendor bump PR, rebase and add a comment 'lockfile: ok' so I can pick it up.

ajay: Re: the grpc-go bump in my branch (#1234) — tests are flaky on macos. Re-running locally now, will ping when green.

ben: FYI I have a tiny Dockerfile change required for go1.20 pin. I'll make a follow-up PR; want to avoid breaking the vendor roll.

sylvie: Can you share the exact commands you'll run for the vendor sync and lockfile regeneration? I'll mirror the steps in my environment.

maria: Sure — the steps I'm using locally (will run in CI as well):
```bash
# update submodules to target commits
git submodule update --init --recursive
cd third_party/foo && git fetch origin && git checkout v2.3.1 && cd -
# regenerate vendor tree (project specific)
./scripts/vendor_sync.sh --from=main --to=release-1.12 --ignore-tests
# go/python/node workflows
make tidy-mods && ./scripts/generate-lockfile.sh
# run quick smoke
./tools/smoke.sh --subset=deps
```
If you prefer a single squashed commit for vendor changes, say so now. I'll open the consolidated PR with everything squashed unless someone asks to keep separate.

release-bot: merge-queue: status update — queue length 3, next auto-merge window opens in 12m. :robot_face:

ajay: Rebased and pushed, added the 'lockfile: ok' comment. @lina fyi — the jpeg-lib bump might interact with your imaging change.

lina: Thanks for the ping @ajay — I'll run a quick integration run against my branch and report back in 10m.

ben: I can squash vendor commits into one; +1 for squashing unless folks want full history.

sylvie: Squash preferred from my side. Also: use this to generate changelog snippet: `./scripts/generate-changelog --from=release-1.11 --to=release-1.12 --format=short` — it outputs PR lines you can paste into the release notes.

ci-bot: CI: smoke tests passed for commit abc123 (18m). All green except one flaky macos job which is queued for rerun.

maria: Great progress, thanks. Final call for any last-minute dependency additions: 17:30 UTC. I'll start the lockfile bump & open the consolidated PR at 17:40 UTC and tag owners. If anything blocks, ping me directly or drop updates here. :thumbsup:

ajay: On it. Re-running tests now, will update in-thread.

lina: Integration run succeeded locally for jpeg-lib bump. No regressions seen in basic imaging e2e.

maria: Perfect — thanks everyone. If you want different commit shapes (separate vs squashed), tell me before 17:35 UTC. Otherwise I'll squash vendor churn into a single commit and attach changelog snippets to the PR description.

ben: Sounds good. Thanks for coordinating.

maria: Anchoring final times here: lockfile cutoff (no new deps) 17:30 UTC, opening consolidated PR 17:40 UTC, merge window to start 18:00 UTC. I'll post the PR link when ready.
